featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic's Boris Cherny said the next Claude Code version makes subagents run in the background by default, so you can keep talking to Claude while subagents work. If you want foreground execution, just tell Claude. It's a notable shift toward non-blocking orchestration—the same "main agent orchestrates, subagents run async" pattern is becoming the default across agentic coding tools.
featured.insightZh: Claude Code 下一个版本要把 subagent 默认改成后台运行——这是个挺关键的交互转向。以前你 spawn 一个子代理，主线程就得干等它跑完；新版里子代理在后台干活，你可以继续跟 Claude 对话，需要前台执行的话直接告诉它就行。这跟 OpenClaw 这边「push-based 完成通知 + 主 session 不阻塞」的设计思路是一回事，说明「主代理编排 + 子代理异步执行」正在成为 agentic coding 工具的标配范式。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux shipped two things. First, a rare transparent postmortem on Codex usage burning faster than expected: not one central bug, but several compounding—overly proactive auto-review, more subagent work, duplicate/over-retrying background suggestions. All reverted and fixed; auto-review is now its own metering category (it had been mislabeled as GPT-5.4 usage), and failed/rate-limited requests no longer count as turns. Usage limits were reset for everyone. Second, a replacement for coarse sandb…
featured.insightZh: Sottiaux 这周做了两件实事。一是回应了 Codex「用量消耗比预期快」的投诉，给出了少见的透明 postmortem：不是单一 bug，而是 auto-review 变得过于主动、subagent 触发增多、后台建议重复运行/失败后过度重试等几个小问题叠加。已全部回滚修复，并把 auto-review 单列为一个计量类别（之前被错记成 GPT-5.4 用量），失败/限流请求不再计入轮次。同时给所有用户重置了用量额度。二是给高级用户上了新能力：用可复用、可继承的「权限 profile」替代粗粒度 sandbox 模式——把 OS 强制的文件读/写/拒绝规则（连 /*.env 都能挡）绑定到按域名的网络 + Unix socket，外加 fail-closed 的 admin 白名单，做到每个任务最小权限。

items.title: Madhu Guru · 前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 产品负责人
items.summaryEn: Former Google product lead Madhu Guru offered a counterintuitive take: the rise of strong open-weight models like GLM will actually strengthen Google's position. More companies will start fine-tuning open-weight models, and the value accrues to infra. Enterprises want flexibility to run and fine-tune open models on a managed platform with enterprise-grade reliability, security, and support—and Google Cloud is well positioned, owning much of the compute stack too. A neat mirror image of Aaron Levie's open-vs-closed…
items.insightZh: 前 Google 产品负责人 Madhu Guru 给了个反直觉判断：GLM 这类强开源权重模型崛起，反而会强化 Google 的地位。逻辑是——越来越多公司会开始拿 GLM 这种开源权重模型做 fine-tuning，而价值最终沉淀到基础设施层。企业想要的是「在一个托管平台上灵活运行和微调开源模型，同时拿到企业级的可靠性、安全和支持」，Google Cloud 正好卡在这个位置，更别说 Google 自己还掌握着大部分算力栈。这跟下面 Aaron Levie 的「开源能否紧追前沿」之辩正好互为镜像。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie framed one of AI's central debates: if a closed stack is perpetually at the frontier by a wide margin, vertical integration and US gatekeeping can work—you control who gets the best tech, and demand favors you. But if open-weights AI stays a close second, the equation reverses: under heavy regulation you'd still own the frontier market, but the vast majority of tokens go to an alternative stack (model plus hardware) controlled and monetized by someone else. Your view on how close open-weights c…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 把当下 AI 最核心的一场辩论讲清楚了：如果闭源栈永远以巨大优势领先前沿，那垂直整合 + 在美国设门槛就行得通——你始终控制谁能拿到最好的技术，需求又足够高，天然对你有利。但如果开源权重 AI 能稳定保持在前沿之后一个身位，等式就反过来了：高度管制下你还能拿下前沿市场，可绝大多数 token 会流向另一套栈（模型 + 底层硬件），而那套栈由别人控制和变现。换句话说，你对「开源能逼近前沿到什么程度」「多少 token 走前沿 vs 其余」的判断，直接决定你对 AI 该如何监管和管控的立场。

items.title: Claude (Anthropic) · 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Anthropic announced Claude is now generally available in Microsoft Foundry, hosted on Azure. Azure customers get Claude Opus 4.8 and Claude Haiku 4.5 with Azure authentication, billing, and commitment retirement. Inference runs on Azure infrastructure operated by Anthropic, with prompt caching and extended thinking supported today and more coming. For enterprise teams in the Microsoft ecosystem, this means wiring Claude into existing Azure workflows without going around procurement—worth watching for the Accenture…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方宣布：Claude 正式在 Microsoft Foundry 全面可用（GA），托管在 Azure 上。Azure 客户现在能直接用 Claude Opus 4.8 和 Claude Haiku 4.5，走 Azure 的认证、计费和 commitment retirement 体系。推理跑在 Azure 基础设施上、由 Anthropic 运营，已支持 prompt caching 和 extended thinking，后续还有更多能力。对在 Microsoft 生态做企业落地的团队，这意味着不用绕开采购体系就能把 Claude 接进现有 Azure 工作流——对 Accenture × Microsoft 这条线尤其值得盯。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang shared a take plus a tool. The take: "the market value of writing has gone way up" (per an Anthropic PM)—good writing and clear articulation are now required both for building products (steering models effectively) and building an audience, and writing has been undervalued in tech for too long. The tool: a Chrome extension that turns your "read later" list into calendar time—save 5 articles and it auto-books a 30-min reading block on Google Calendar with links included. No account, no server, all local,…
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 这周抛了个观点 + 一个小工具。观点：「写作的市场价值大涨了」（引用一位 Anthropic PM 的说法）——无论是做产品（有效 steer 模型需要清晰表达）还是建立受众，好的写作/清晰articulation 都成了硬通货。写作能力在科技圈历来被低估，是时候改了。工具：她做了个 Chrome 扩展，把「稍后读」清单变成日历上的专属阅读时间——存 5 篇文章，就自动在 Google 日历上订一个 30 分钟「阅读 block」并附上链接，逼你真坐下来读完。无账号、无服务器、全本地、开源。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Roblox product lead Peter Yang had a practical observation: for writing and editing, plain vanilla Claude web is still the best—better than Codex and Claude Code. His guess is that something in the coding agents' system prompts makes them worse writers. It dovetails with Zara's point above on writing's rising value: pick the right tool for the job, since a coding-optimized agent isn't automatically a great writing tool.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 这周有个实用观察：纯写作和编辑场景，原版 Claude 网页端依然是最好的——比 Codex 和 Claude Code 都强。他猜是这些 coding agent 的 system prompt 里某些东西把它们的写作能力搞差了。这跟 Zara 上面「写作价值大涨」的判断刚好对得上：工具选型上，专为 coding 优化的 agent 不等于通用写作神器，挑对工具比堆功能更重要。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Anthropic Claude Code's Thariq shared his current writing process, useful for anyone serious about producing content: do some engineering work, talk to a bunch of people, brainstorm and research with Claude, write a post, give 1-2 talks, rewrite, give another talk, rewrite the intro, wake up at 6am and rewrite again, then post. The point isn't one-click AI generation—it's treating writing as a long practice-talk-iterate loop, with AI accelerating the research and polish.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 分享了他现在的写作流程，对任何想认真产出内容的人都有参考价值：先做点工程实践 → 跟一堆人聊 → 用 Claude 头脑风暴和调研 → 写一版 → 做 1-2 场分享 → 重写 → 再讲一场 → 重写开头 → 早上 6 点起来再重写一遍 → 才发。核心不是「让 AI 一键生成」，而是把写作当成「实践—交流—迭代」的长循环，AI 只是其中加速调研和打磨的环节。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch teased a capability jump: 20x larger functions on Vercel, plus "you can deploy anything and everything to Vercel, more tomorrow." For teams building AI apps, larger function limits mean heavier inference/build workloads can run directly on serverless without re-architecting around size caps—another step toward serverless becoming AI-workload-friendly.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 预告了平台的一次能力跃升：Vercel 上的 function 体积放大到 20 倍，并且「什么都能往 Vercel 上部署，明天有更多」。对做 AI 应用的团队，更大的 function 上限意味着可以把更重的推理/构建工作负载直接跑在 serverless 上，不用再为体积限制拆架构——这是 serverless 往「AI 工作负载友好」方向推进的又一步。

items.title: Swyx · AI Engineer / Latent Space
items.summaryEn: Swyx shared a telling signal from the AI Engineer Expo: non-lab workshops at 9am on a Monday (Snyk, Atlassian, neo4j, Arize, Akamai, Together running concurrently), with a competing OpenAI workshop next door, were still packed—"PEOPLE ARE HUNGRY FOR THIS." A simple but real industry thermometer: demand for hands-on, practical AI engineering content is far from saturated.
items.insightZh: Swyx 从 AI Engineer Expo 现场发来一个值得注意的信号：周一上午 9 点的非实验室 workshop（Snyk、Atlassian、neo4j、Arize、Akamai、Together 等同时开），即便隔壁还有 OpenAI 的竞品 workshop，房间照样爆满——「PEOPLE ARE HUNGRY FOR THIS」。一个朴素但真实的行业温度计：从业者对动手实操、可落地的 AI 工程内容的需求远没饱和。

items.title: An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
items.summaryEn: Anthropic published a rare postmortem tracing a month of "Claude got worse" reports to three independent changes (the API was unaffected; all fixed in v2.1.116 on April 20). One: a March 4 switch of default reasoning effort from high to medium to cut latency—the wrong tradeoff, reverted April 7 (Opus 4.7 now defaults to xhigh, other models to high). Two: a March 26 caching bug that cleared old thinking every turn instead of once, making Claude forgetful and repetitive and draining usage limits faster—fixed April 10. Three: an April 16 system-prompt line capping verbosity (≤25 words between tool calls, ≤100-word final responses) that cost Opus 4.6/4.7 a 3% drop on one eval—reverted April 20. The most useful part for engineering teams is the fixes: per-line ablations plus full-model eval suites for every system-prompt change, soak periods, broader evals, and gradual rollouts for anything…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 罕见地公开了 Claude Code 近期质量下降的 postmortem，把过去一个月「Claude 变笨」的投诉追溯到三个独立改动（API 未受影响，均已于 4 月 20 日 v2.1.116 修复）。一是 3 月 4 日把默认 reasoning effort 从 high 降到 medium 以减少延迟——这是个错误权衡，4 月 7 日已回滚（现在 Opus 4.7 默认 xhigh，其余模型默认 high）。二是 3 月 26 日一个缓存优化 bug：本该只清理一次的旧 thinking，结果每轮都清，导致 Claude「健忘、重复、工具选择乱来」，还连带把用量额度更快耗尽，4 月 10 日修复。三是 4 月 16 日加的一条降 verbosity 的 system prompt 指令（限制工具调用间≤25词、最终回复≤100词）——在一项评测里让 Opus 4.6/4.7 掉了 3%，4 月 20 日回滚。 最值得工程团队记住的是它们的改进措施：对每次 system prompt 改动跑「逐行消融（ablation）+ 全模型评测套件」，给可能牺牲智能的改动加 soak period、更广评测、灰度发布，并把 model-specific 改动严格 gate 到目标模型。一个有意思的细节：回测时 Opus 4.7 能在完整仓库上下文下找出那个缓存 bug，而 Opus 4.6 找不到——于是他们决定给 Code Review 加更多仓库上下文支持。

items.title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
items.summaryEn: Anthropic Engineering details the core of Managed Agents: decoupling the "brain" (Claude plus harness) from the "hands" (sandboxes and tools) and the "session" (event log), so each can fail or be replaced independently. They started by cramming everything into one container and ended up with a "pet"—if the container died, the session was lost and needed manual nursing. The fix borrows OS virtualization: abstract session, harness, and sandbox into stable interfaces (execute, provision, wake, getSession, emitEvent), letting implementations swap freely as models improve, just as read() doesn't care if it's a 1970s disk or a modern SSD. The payoffs: the harness becomes stateless "cattle," recovering via wake(sessionId) from the session log; credentials never reach the sandbox (Git tokens injected into the remote at init, MCP via a vault-backed proxy); and containers are provisioned on deman…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 工程团队详解了 Managed Agents 的架构核心：把「大脑」（Claude + harness）与「双手」（sandbox + 工具）和「会话」（事件日志）解耦，三者各自可独立失败和替换。最初他们把所有组件塞进一个容器，结果养出了「宠物」——容器一挂，整个 session 就丢，还得人工抢救。解法是借鉴操作系统的虚拟化思路：把 session、harness、sandbox 抽象成稳定接口（execute、provision、wake、getSession、emitEvent），让底层实现可随模型进步自由替换，就像 read() 不在乎底下是 1970 年代磁盘还是现代 SSD。 几个硬收益：harness 移出容器后变成无状态「牛」，崩了直接 wake(sessionId) 从事件日志恢复；安全上让凭据永不进入 sandbox（Git token 在初始化时注入 remote、MCP 走带 vault 的代理）；性能上容器改为「按需 by the brain 调用」，p50 TTFT 降约 60%、p95 降超 90%。一个反复出现的主题是「harness 编码了对 Claude 不能做什么的假设，而这些假设会随模型变强而过时」——比如他们为 Sonnet 4.5 的「context anxiety」加的 context reset，到 Opus 4.5 就成了死代码。

items.title: New in Claude Managed Agents: self-hosted sandboxes and MCP tunnels
items.summaryEn: Claude Managed Agents adds two enterprise capabilities: self-hosted sandboxes (public beta) and MCP tunnels (research preview). The first runs tool execution on your own infrastructure or managed providers (Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, Vercel), while the agent loop—orchestration, context management, error recovery—stays on Anthropic's side; sensitive files, packages, and services never leave your perimeter, and you control compute sizing and the runtime image. The second lets agents reach MCP servers inside your private network without public exposure: a lightweight gateway makes a single outbound connection, no inbound firewall rules, no public endpoints, traffic encrypted end to end—turning internal databases, private APIs, knowledge bases, and ticketing systems into callable tools. items.insightZh: Claude Managed Agents 上新两项企业级能力：自托管 sandbox（公开 beta）和 MCP tunnels（research preview）。前者让 agent 的工具执行环境跑在你自己的基础设施、或 Cloudflare / Daytona / Modal / Vercel 等托管 provider 上——编排、上下文管理、错误恢复仍留在 Anthropic 侧，但敏感文件、依赖包和服务不离开你的边界，网络策略、审计日志、安全工具沿用现有那套，算力规格和运行镜像也由你定。后者让 agent 不暴露到公网就能连到你私有网络里的 MCP server：你部署一个轻量 gateway 发起单条出站连接，无需入站防火墙规则、无公开端点、流量端到端加密，内部数据库、私有 API、知识库、工单系统都能变成 agent 可调用的工具。 文中给了几个真实落地案例：Amplitude 在 Managed Agents + Cloudflare 上建内部 Design Agent；Clay 的 GTM 工程 agent Sculptor 跑在 Managed Agents + Daytona 上自主构建测试监控 workflow；面向机构金融的 Rogo 用 Managed Agents + Vercel Sandbox 安全处理专有数据。对在企业内做 agent 落地、又卡在「数据不能出域」合规要求上的团队，这两项基本是为你准备的。
